verdict.rationale: Gitea's own marketing page lists "SAML SSO Integration" as a feature (alongside Audit Logs), so a first-party SAML capability is claimed. Nothing in the pack shows it can be required or enforced for an organization, or how it is configured. The community mention of Gitea acting as an OIDC identity provider is a different protocol and role, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documentation of SAML configuration, the ability to enforce or require SSO at the organization level, which edition or tier includes it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
